title: Motion for an extension of time to file the joint appendix and petitioner's brief on the merits submitted

October 22, 2025
VIA ELECTRONIC FILING

Mr. Scott Harris, Clerk
Supreme Court of the United States
One First Street NE
Washington, DC 20543

Re: Pung v. Isabella County, No. 25-95

Dear Mr. Harris:

Certiorari was granted in the above-captioned matter on October 3, 2025, and
Petitioner’s Opening Brief and the Joint Appendix are currently due by
November 17, 2025.

Petitioner’s Counsel of Record is a solo practitioner with other pressing
matters, including a previously scheduled oral argument at the Sixth Circuit
this week and another petition for certiorari (Case No. 25-487) that was just
filed in this court. Petitioner has also added additional counsel to assist,
namely a public interest law firm with experience in the matters at issue. Newly
associated counsel need time to help assisting me  in preparation of  the
Opening Brief and Joint Appendix.

Accordingly, Petitioner respectfully requests under Rule 30.4 of the Rules of
this Court that the deadline for Petitioners’ Opening Brief and Joint Appendix
be extended by two weeks, to and including December 1, 2025.

Best regards,

Philip L. Ellison
Attorney at Law

CC: All counsel of record (via electronic filing and email)
